acquisition-acquisition:ashbyhq:93bfc0b6.title: Director of Sales Workshops
acquisition-acquisition:ashbyhq:93bfc0b6.description: ROLE As the Director of Sales Workshops, you'll teach entrepreneurs the Acquisition.com http://Acquisition.com sales frameworks from the stage and the round-tables, alongside the marketing, finance, and operations context that makes them work. You'll present to a room full of founders, then go deeper to help them unpack their specific business constraints. The frameworks and the access are already ours; your job is to make them land. The hard part is holding the room, making complex frameworks simple, answering hard questions in real time, and then helping a founder see what they cannot see about their own business. Events run two days: a presentation-heavy first day teaching the full room from the stage, then a more intimate second day going deeper with business owners around the table. Between events, the work is studying, researching incoming cohorts, answering founder follow-ups, running a retrospective on the last event, and continuing to iterate on the format and materials. The stage is the visible part; the preparation and iteration around it are most of the job. You'll present workshops on stage within your first 30 days. We view our Advisory Practice as a professional sport and we welcome your application if you're up for the challenge! RESPONSIBILITIES - Present to founders: teach the Acquisition.com http://Acquisition.com sales frameworks on stage, with the marketing, finance, and operations context that makes them work. - Make the frameworks land: translate frameworks into clear lessons that founders can apply immediately, across sales, marketing, finance, and operations. - Diagnose business constraints: go deeper in intimate round-tables and sidebar conversations to help founders identify their core problem. - Study incoming cohorts: between events, research the next group of business owners and prepare rigorously for the room. - Hone your craft: run a retrospective after each event, answer founder follow-ups, and iterate on the format, materials, and presentation. - Strengthen your team: collaborate with peers across the Advisory Practice and ACQ, and help your teammates get better. REQUIREMENTS - Commands a room, large or small. Holds the stage, draws people out at the table, and fields hard questions live. Presence, not rah-rah charisma. - Deep in sales, fluent enough in marketing, finance, and operations to read the whole business, and able to make it all simple. - Scaled or exited a business as an operator who owned the P&L, at least seven figures. You diagnose from having carried the number, not just advised on it. - All in and self-directed: fully committed with no outside company, energized by the prep between events as much as the stage. - Relentless about improving the craft, treating every event as a chance to get sharper. - Makes the whole team better, not just yourself, and easy to build with. RESULTS - Founders leave each event able to name the true constraint in their business - Founders experience a moment of clarity that changes how they think about their company and their role as CEO - Both days land: the presentation holds the full room, and the round-tables move each founder forward - Event satisfaction and engagement scores stay high, and founder follow-ups are answered promptly - Each event improves on the last through your retrospectives and iteration - You present on stage within your first 30 days - The advisory team performs better because of your contribution SCHEDULE - Between events, standard business hours spent researching incoming cohorts, answering founder follow-ups, running event retrospectives, and iterating on the material - On the two-day events, expect long days, roughly 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, plus preparation and debrief around them LOCATION - Las Vegas, NV (onsite) - Relocation support provided; short-term travel during relocation may be acceptable for the first one to two months COMPENSATION - $200,000 to $260,000 base salary plus up to 20 percent annual bonus - The salary ra

Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a General Managerat Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the store by leading high-performing retail and culinary teams that inspires customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. This position combines strategic business acumen with strong operational expertise to drive both culinary and retail business performance while delivering #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Recruit, develop and retain a high-performing team to meet the business needs of both culinary and retail. · Lead, coach, and inspire associates to exceed performance expectations and uphold a positive team culture. · Conduct regular performance evaluations, provide feedback, and create development plans to support individual and team growth. Operations & Compliance · Oversee daily store operations, ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and ensure proper product merchandising. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Maintains the accuracy and integrity of associates’ records, including but not limited to time and attendance data, food safety certifications, and personal information. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. jobgether-jobgether:lever:1ba07bc4-563d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical SR&ED Writer (Software Focus) based in Canada. This is a fully remote opportunity for a technically strong writer who understands both software development and Canada’s SR&ED framework. You will take ownership of technical claim narratives, turning complex R&D work into clear, rigorous, and CRA-compliant documentation. The role involves working directly with CTOs, developers, engineers, and other technical stakeholders to uncover technological uncertainties, experimentation, and advancements. You’ll work across areas such as machine learning, cloud infrastructure, embedded systems, and enterprise software. Success requires a combination of software expertise, exceptional writing, strong investigative skills, and the ability to manage multiple client deadlines. You’ll collaborate with project and financial teams to connect technical narratives with eligible expenditures and ensure claims are well supported. This is an opportunity to have immediate ownership and client impact while growing toward a senior advisory or technical leadership path. Conduct in-depth interviews with CTOs, software engineers, developers, and technical teams to identify and document eligible R&D activities. Analyze complex software development projects and extract the technical details, experimentation, challenges, and outcomes required to build compelling SR&ED claims. Collaborate with project managers and financial teams to align technical narratives with eligible expenditures and broader claim requirements. Manage multiple client engagements and claim deadlines simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of accuracy, organization, and responsiveness. Build strong relationships with clients and serve as a trusted partner throughout the technical documentation process. Research and monitor updates to CRA SR&ED guidelines, requirements, and best practices to ensure deliverables remain current and compliant. Review, edit, and refine technical documentation to ensure consistency, clarity, completeness, and audit readiness. Contribute technical insight to a collaborative environment involving engineers, advisors, grant specialists, and other subject-matter experts. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. 2+ years of direct experience preparing SR&ED claims, either within a consultancy or an internal organization. Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, system architecture, algorithms, technical experimentation, and software engineering practices. Strong analytical and investigative abilities, with a methodical approach to understanding unfamiliar technologies and technical challenges. Excellent attention to detail and a strong understanding of the importance of accuracy and compliance in technical documentation. Ability to manage multiple projects, competing deadlines, and client relationships in a fast-paced remote environment. s2ginvestments-earthoptics:bamboohr:371.title: Production Technician - Genomics
s2ginvestments-earthoptics:bamboohr:371.description: Join EarthOptics as a Production Technician - Genomics ! At EarthOptics we are combining cutting-edge genomic analysis, data science, microbiology, and remote sensing to revolutionize agriculture. Our mission is to help farmers and ranchers sustainably increase their yields and feed the growing world through all things soil. We are a growing company with a passion for soil health, innovative technologies, and supporting all within the food value chain. We currently have ~100 individuals spread across 20 states and two countries, and they come from all walks of life, industries, and experiences. We are deeply focused on building the future of AgTech and sustainability and helping the world see soil differently. The Production Technician - Genomics will join our Emeryville, CA Lab team to impact our mission through individual contributor responsibilities. In this role, you will perform routine molecular biology and production activities, including DNA extraction, sample preparation, equipment operation, and documentation in accordance with established standard operating procedures. You will help ensure that samples are processed safely, accurately, and efficiently in a fast-paced laboratory environment. Regardless of the role, our team embraces learning, craves collaboration, and is driven by a fast-paced environment. If you resonate with our values and goals, we encourage you to apply—even if you don't meet every requirement. The digs: Job Type: Part-Time, Non-Exempt, Temporary to Regular, Part-Time after 90-days based on performance and business needs Work Location: This is an onsite position in our Emeryville, CA office and laboratory Schedule: The role is 30 hours per week. Operations may occur seven (7) days per week during peak season. Employees may be scheduled for day, evening, and occasional weekend shifts. The actual days worked will vary (e.g., Tuesday–Saturday or Wednesday–Saturday) based on operational needs. Target Start Date: August 31, 2026 or September 14, 2026 Compensation: $22.00 per hour What you’ll cultivate as a Production Technician-Genomics: (Your responsibilities) Ensure production spaces are kept clean, organized and compliant with safety protocols Execute daily tasks according to established procedures and quality standards Process assigned sample volumes accurately and efficiently while meeting established throughput and quality expectations. Set up and operate equipment (liquid handlers, centrifuges, autoclaves, pipettes, etc.) according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and monitor machines and tools used in the production process Safely prepare and handle reagents and waste involved in DNA extraction and sequencing (PPE provided) Organize (label, package, store) processed samples in accordance with workplace procedures Complete routine equipment cleaning, inspection, and basic maintenance in accordance with SOPs, and promptly report equipment issues. Record production data and complete required documentation Adhere to safety guidelines and regulatory requirements Are you our soil-mate? You’ll bloom in this role if you have experience in: (Your qualifications) High school diploma or equivalent required. An associate or bachelor’s degree in a laboratory science or related field is preferred. Equivalent experience may substitute for education. Demonstrated ability to multitask and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. Exceptional reliability through consistent attendance, punctuality, and dependability. Fosters a respectful workplace by building professional relationships and collaborating positively with all team members. Adapts to flexible working hours, with availability for occasional after-hours work. Applies strong attention to detail in all work tasks. Works comfortably with large volumes of soil and soil slurry. Performs repetitive tasks with consistent quality and focus. Adheres to all safety procedures and utilizes provided PPE. Proficiency in basic computer/IT troubleshooting

southparkcommons-meesho:lever:7bb1de7e-8.title: Software Development Engineer III Data
southparkcommons-meesho:lever:7bb1de7e-8.description: When 5% of Indian households shop with us, it’s important to build data-backed, resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We’ve done this – with zero downtime! 😎 Sounds impossible? Well, that’s the kind of Engineering muscle that has helped Meesho become the e-commerce giant that it is today. We value speed over perfection, and see failures as opportunities to become better. We’ve taken steps to inculcate a strong ‘Founder’s Mindset’ across our engineering teams, making us grow and move fast. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member - and we do this with regular 1-1s and open communication. Tech Culture We have a unique tech culture where engineers are seen as problem solvers. The engineering org is divided into multiple pods and each pod is aligned to a particular business theme. It is a culture driven by logical debates & arguments rather than authority. At Meesho, you get to solve hard technical problems at scale as well as have a significant impact on the lives of millions of entrepreneurs. You are expected to contribute to the Solutioning of product problems as well as challenge existing solutions. Meesho’s user base has grown 4x in the last 1 year and we have more than 50 million downloads of our app. Here are a few projects we have completed last year to scale oursystems for this growth: ● We have developed API gateway aggregators using frameworks like Hystrix and spring-cloud-gateway for circuit breaking and parallel processing. ● Our serving microservices handle more than 15K RPS on normal days and during saledays this can go to 30K RPS. Being a consumer app, these systems have SLAs of ~10ms ● Our distributed scheduler tracks more than 50 million shipments periodically fromdifferent partners and does async processing involving RDBMS. ● We use an in-house video streaming platform to support a wide variety of devices and networks.

southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:c889b8.title: Product Operations
southparkcommons-profound:ashbyhq:c889b8.description: Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. The way brands reach people is being rewritten — AI models like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode are now the answer layer between companies and their customers. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage. We went from 0 to a $1B valuation in 18 months. Revenue grew 100x last year. Our customers include 15% of the Fortune 500 like Walmart, Wayfair and U.S. Bank, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. We are backed by Sequoia, Kleiner Perkins, LSVP, and Khosla Ventures — and we are moving fast enough that the people joining now are building the playbook everyone who comes after them will run. We are hiring for Product Operations to sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and go-to-market, serving as the connective tissue between our product team and the customers, partners, and internal teams who depend on it. You'll bring Profound's platform to life through templates, enablement, demos, and deep product expertise, helping us scale without losing the product clarity that got us here. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Lead feature-specific product ops work across all our products, owning the operational layer from launch prep through adoption tracking - Act as the voice of the customer inside the product org, synthesizing feedback from support, sales, and customer conversations into concrete, prioritized product input - Support sales enablement by educating the GTM team on product releases, building release notes, internal guides, and demo scripts that help sellers articulate value immediately - Own the product and engineering update for the full company, synthesizing what shipped, what's coming, and why it matters into a communication cadence that keeps every team aligned and informed - Work directly with Agent Engineering to create, iterate, and improve agent templates, translating product capabilities into reusable, customer-ready formats - Evaluate third-party partnerships, review proposals, ask sharp product questions, stress-test integrations, and surface risks or gaps before they become commitments - Build and maintain product documentation, launch playbooks, and internal wikis so institutional product knowledge scales beyond the heads of a few engineers - Track product adoption metrics and feature usage post-launch, identifying what's working, what's not, and flagging signals that should influence roadmap decisions WHO YOU ARE - Product-minded with a bias toward action: you see a gap between what exists and what should exist and immediately start closing it - Strong communicator, written and verbal, able to work with both engineering and sales teams - Able to operate in a fast-moving, early-stage environment with minimal direction: you're comfortable figuring out what matters and getting to work without a playbook - Technically fluent enough to work directly with engineers: you understand how the product is built, can read a spec, ask sharp questions, and spot when something doesn't add up - Customer-empathetic: you can translate what customers need into concrete product feedback, and you treat customer signal as one of the most valuable inputs in the building process - Highly organized with the ability to hold a lot of context at once: multiple features in flight, different stakeholder needs, different release timelines, without anything falling through the cracks LOCATION This is an on-site role based in our Union Square, NYC office, designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact. For this role, the expected base salary range is $100,000 to $150,000, depending on experience. Profound's total compensation package includes base salary, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks.
